notes: Read all 222 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the ChartExportMenu public props, open state, close callback, trigger labels, CSV/PNG/SVG/copy callbacks, disabled gate, busy gate, and clipboard outcome handling.

Converted the web div/Button/button menu and lucide Copy/Download/FileImage/FileSpreadsheet/Image icons to React Native View/Pressable/Modal primitives with TeslaSync AppText, SemanticIcon glyphs, and native design tokens.
Replaced document mousedown/Escape listeners with a transparent native Modal backdrop and onRequestClose so outside dismissal and hardware-back dismissal remain native-safe without browser globals.

The web optional toast provider has no native equivalent in this parity tree, so clipboard copied/fallback/failed outcomes are surfaced through an inline accessible notice while keeping the same i18n keys and fallback messages.
No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported by the native output.
